profile.headline: Senior Frontend Engineer | Delivering Scalable Web Solutions
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Software Engineer specializing in front-end development. Proven track of expertise with Angular and React. Highly adaptable team member who thrives in collaborating with other to deliver robust, cutting-edge solutions and satisfy customer needs.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Project Management · React · TypeScript · react query · JSON Web Token (JWT) · HTML5 · Material-UI · vite · Webpack · rollup · Keycloak · OAuth · Three.js · Jest · REST APIs · Figma (Software) · Bitbucket · Asana · JIRA · Storybook · Agile Project Management · Agile Web Development · Technical Recruiting · postman

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Spearheaded the design, development, and deployment of DMH, an Angular 14 application that provided AI-powered digital asset management and monetization solutions.
- Maintained and supervised a comprehensive suite of over 400,000 Angular unit tests, reducing front-end related defcon issues by 99% and increased code coverage by 95%.
- Collaborated with the design and development of the Web Attribution project, directly enabling the Broadcast team to secure a $2M contract. 
- Engineered the design and implementation of the interface for a Synthetic Voice Generative AI Service prototype, directly contributing to the founding of the AI service team.
- Lead a team of 5 engineers to design and implement an Advertisement Booking Planner application, increasing advertising booking deals by 500%.
- Managed a team of 3 full-time engineers to migrate JavaScript React applications to Typescript.
- Partnered with the UX team to architect and implement a shared component system using Storybook.
- Co-founded the Technical Leadership Team, aligning engineering and management core values to improve engineering satisfaction and recognition including future promotions.
- Mentored junior engineers and offshore contractors, directly contributing to the promotion of two junior engineers within one year.
- Managed weekly front-end engineering demos and workshops, increasing front-end best practices and adoption of new tools and technologies.
- Streamlined development workflows by implementing and configuring CI/CD pipelines for different front-end projects using Docker and Jenkins.
- Championed a documentation initiative to set up new front-end projects and implement required Oauth workflows, reducing the creation of new front-end projects by 70%.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML5 · RxJS · Front-End Development · Software Development · Material-UI · OAuth · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · TypeScript · GraphQL · Angular · Node.js · Webpack · Angular Material · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · JavaScript · Angular CLI · React.js · JIRA · AngularJS · Redux.js · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented an Enterprise Flex Application using Adobe Flex and ActionScript 3.
- Collaborated to the migration of an Enterprise Flex Application to Angular 6, NGRX, and PrimeNG.
- Mentored junior engineers and offshore contractors.
- Performed daily code reviews for both front-end and back-end teams.
- Partnered with the UX team to design wireframes, mockups, and develop prototypes.
- Maintained an Enterprise back-end System using Java and Spring Framework.
- Engineered RESTful Web Services using Spring MVC.
- Architected full-stack data solutions including robust CRUD operations and optimized SQL stored procedures.
- Spearheaded the creation and implementation of API documentation using Swagger Editor.
positions.insights: Skills: ActionScript · Front-End Development · Spring Framework · Flex · Spring MVC · Oracle Database · TypeScript · Angular · Model-View-Controller (MVC) · Ngrx · Java · JavaScript · Spring Boot · SQL

positions.title: Desktop Support
positions.description:
- Designed and developed an internal Payroll Report System using Java GUI and SQL.
- Developed a Software License Monitoring System for the Computer Labs using C#.
- Maintained an Inventory System for the Computer Labs using PHP and SQL.
- Provided Hardware, Software, and Networking solutions for faculty and students.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · C# · Java · SQL · Network Administration
